command: scripts/lib/capture-openclaw-provider-failed.sh — a throwaway OpenClaw home whose only provider is a closed loopback port, the plugin `pixtuoid connect openclaw` installs there, `openclaw gateway run`, one `openclaw agent -m <prompt>` turn, then SIGTERM
note: A failed provider, from real bytes: the gateway retries the attempt, and every attempt's `agent_end` carries no upstream `error` (upstream's `success` is true: `!aborted && !promptError`, and a refused connection is neither) and the plugin's `errored:true`, read off the attempt's last `model_call_ended`. The plugin forwards no `success`. No model call was made: the provider refuses at connect. cli and version were set by hand: the recorder probes the driver script's `--version`.
